cases.name: Cassidy Rose Karels
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Cassidy was a middle child through and through having to be tough to handle her own with both her older and younger brothers. She was truly a "sour patch kid" switching between sour and super sweet moments. She loved to play with her dolls and makeup. She loved to eat anything and everything as she truly enjoyed food like her mother. She was a tough girl with a girly side and an adorable, contagious laugh. Cassidy was described as tough, cute, sweet, and sassy."
cases.narrative: On 6/13/2022, her mother Debbie went to her father's house to pick her and her 2 brothers up from a weekend visitation, and found her three children dead in a bedroom. Jason later gave a detailed statement to investigators about how he drowned each child one by one in a bathtub.
